name: smwmusic-deltarune-a-dark-zone
title: Deltarune - A DARK ZONE
description:
The song "A DARK ZONE" from Chapter 4 of Deltarune, which plays in the boss fight against Jackenstein, originally composed by Toby Fox. Would fit in spooky ghost levels and spooky boss fights.

The original samples were found using stormstudios1's Deltarune Sample Sheet.
